notes.title: Steam Award Nomination Request for "100 nya"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26773067/354a6f7aebf9c95b1caa404a0f01c3a5b07f461d.png[/img]
"100 nya" is definitely a game that was created with love and improved over the years. And it will only get better in the future.
A lot has changed since the "GreenLight" event, thanks to you and your care.
Nominate us in the “LABOR OF LOVE” category!

notes.title: Language innovation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26773067/169ddb6244eb41f51a532aa984e74af7fff30442.png[/img]

The game does not stand still and develops as far as possible. Today players from all over the world play our game. And our priority task is to make the pastime in our game as pleasant as possible. Therefore, playing with the interface in the native language of the player is much more pleasant.
.M.Y.W. apologizes to languages ​​consisting of hieroglyphs, as he is afraid to make mistakes when translating through Google Translate.

.M.Y.W. wishes you a pleasant pastime in our games "100 nya" and "Hot Earth"!

notes.title: Happy new 2020 year!
notes.content:
Dear friends!
The year 2019 is nearing completion.
We have made updates to the game "Hundred".
Also released early access to the game "Heroes of the Earth: Invasion".
Now we are developing the "Third Project", which will embody the continuation of the game "Heroes of the Earth" and the background of the game "Hundred". The exit is planned in mid-2021.
During this time, we will also work on improving existing projects. Complementing game creatures, types of game rooms, as well as access to achievements and the high score table.

We hope for your support during our work. Feedback through gaming communities, your reviews and screenshots of your successes in our games.

We want to wish you happiness, creative success and, of course, health in the new year!

Yours faithfully .M.Y.W.

notes.title: Global Update "100nya"
notes.content:
A new, global update of the game "[b]100nya[/b]" is being developed. In the near future, its price will increase several times. Global update will affect platforms such as [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/553830/100nya/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MYW.Play_100nya_Full]Play Google[/url].

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26773067/fb42ee1eddfd53b223b63194aa8861f887e4d6a6.png[/img]
[u]What awaits us in the new update:[/u]
- First of all, this is a new platform. [b]UWP[/b] is a universal window platform.
(it allows you to run games both on PCs with Windows 10, and on phones equipped with the same Operating System.)
- New [url=https://www.microsoft.com/ru-ru/store/p/100nya/9p7f0qbd00mh]Windows Store[/url] Marketplace (already available)
- The game will use new engine.
- The game will completely change its graphic design.
[u]Throughout the various updates ...[/u]
- The game will add achievements, such as:
a) Achievements of [b]Steam Achivments[/b].
b) [b]Play games[/b]
c) Achievements of [b]XBox[/b]
[u]Yet now ...[/u]
- The game will have three game modes:
a) [b]"[i]Easy[/i]"[/b].
b) [b]"[i]Normal[/i]"[/b].
c) [b]"[i]Hard[/i]"[/b].
- "[b]Easy[/b]" mode will embody the training level. He will show where it is possible to make a move and the number of moves that is available.
- In "[b]Normal[/b]" mode, the game will be blank. You will decide where to start the game.
- In the "[b]Hard[/b]" mode, the cage will be randomly selected, where the game will start, and a timer will appear that will count the time from five to zero
- The spark of the game will be added. While you are getting achievements, special pictures will be opened. "[b]Normal[/b]" mode is (secret drawing), which you can brag to friends.
And in the "[b]Hard[/b]" mode, anime characters, from the universe of our games. [b].M.Y.W.[/b]
Share your impressions in the comments, write reviews. Play in our games and develop with us.

ːMYWː  Yours faithfully [b].M.Y.W.[/b]
